facts.claim: Ryoan-ji has a fifteen-rock dry garden and additional wooded grounds with Kyoyo-chi pond. The guide says the designer and intended meaning are unknown.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: no one knows for certain when the rock garden was made, who designed it, or what the designer’s intentions were
